report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment is unverified. Deployment record shows only baseline order v1.0.0 with no prior version, so it cannot establish deployment-caused errors. Traces show successful 200 checkouts across order, inventory, payment, and postgres. Order metrics show 200s on v1.0.0 with no 5xx and low p95 latency. Logs were excluded. Current telemetry neither confirms checkout errors nor a deployment fault; hand off for more evidence.
missing_evidence: Checkout error logs/error spans showing the actual failure mode and status codes (logs excluded from context).
Order service metrics for the checkout route and error statuses; current metrics show only /v1/orders 200s and no 5xx.
Deployment records for any version other than baseline 1.0.0, plus timing relative to error onset.
Evidence that checkout errors actually occurred; traces show all sampled checkouts returning 200.
